caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with intricate detailing positioned centrally against a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be symmetrical, consisting of two main arms that mirror each other, each terminating in a circular loop. The metal is dark, predominantly brownish-black with lighter highlights to suggest a reflective surface and texture. Both arms exhibit ornate, scalloped edges and are adorned with circular and raised decorative elements, including small metallic studs or rivets. There are two rows of what appear to be coiled or twisted wire elements, rendered in a rust-brown color, running diagonally and connecting points along the arms. The object is slightly angled, giving a sense of depth. There is a small, neat signature of the artist in the lower right-hand corner. The composition is centered and isolated, with ample negative space around the object.
title: Bit
